objective: Community-sourced quality improvements for the local Emilia SDXL workflow, not speed at the expense of finished artwork
hardware: Windows, CMP 40HX 8 GiB Turing sm75, 24 GiB DDR3, existing comfyui Conda environment

sources.observed: Image-to-image redraw on tiles; existing SDXL model and VAE can be reused. No additional runtime dependencies declared in pyproject.toml version1.7.2.

NoUpscale retains input dimensions; low denoise0.05-0.2 suggested to reduce hallucinations/seams; padding provides context; seam fixing adds more redraw and should not be enabled blindly. The file header is malformed but parameter table and tips are readable.

Source repository README and ComfyUI docs link this as the original parameter FAQ. Direct fetch intermittent; claims are based on locally audited upstream source and the independently read ComfyUI docs, not an invented FAQ quotation.

Explains overlap seams and repeated subjects when each tile receives the same prompt. Demonstrates deliberately extreme denoise1 with/without ControlNet Tile; not a recommended denoise1 recipe. Tutorial illustrates TiledDiffusion, not the literal USDU node.

Supports SDXL; Mixture of Diffusers and MultiDiffusion overlap prediction fusion. Dimensions in pixels. Tiled-VAE fast decoder can alter contrast/brightness. Borrowed implementations have CC BY-NC-SA4.0 restrictions.
sources.deployment: Executed successfully, then moved outside custom_nodes; not default because no reliable visual gain and global hooks/license risks

sources.kind: primary node documentation, matching installed local NODES.md
sources.observed: attn_mask is an output-canvas influence mask, black0 white1, same size/aspect as latent canvas; nonsquare reference inputs center crop. start/end timing impacts conditioning. No new face-recognition weights required for the installed Plus Face model.
guide_size may refer to bbox or crop, max_size caps processing canvas. noise_mask_feather changes the inpainting mask and explicitly is not guaranteed better; may produce edge artifacts.

sources.kind: primary implementation and matching local code reviewed by research agent
sources.observed: Positive noise_mask_feather automatically selects Differential Diffusion if no denoise mask function exists. Existing API omitted the option and uses function default0, while GUI defaults must not be assumed executed.

PAG supports SDXL and can strengthen coherence but high scale can oversaturate/fry image. ComfyUI already contains a simpler PAG implementation. Not a guaranteed quality upgrade and adds sampling computation.

candidate_fit.USDU: Audited pinned snapshot with populated submodule executed on this GPU at two denoise settings, then moved outside automatic custom_nodes. No pip or model download. No reliable visual gain selected.
candidate_fit.TiledDiffusion: Audited pinned Python sampler/ControlNet hooks, executed Mixture of Diffusers on the same final PNG, then disabled by moving out of automatic load path. Noncommercial code-license restriction documented; no new weights.
candidate_fit.DifferentialDiffusion: Already available through Impact; compare explicit noise-mask feather8 face/12 hand against API baseline0, no extra package.
candidate_fit.IPAdapter_attention_mask: Uses native mask nodes, no new weights; fixed region may miss a moved face and is not universally safe across arbitrary poses.
candidate_fit.PAG: Native node is available; optional experiment with conservative scale rather than installing a duplicate extension.
candidate_fit.ControlNet_Tile: Not selected as a prerequisite; compatible SDXL weights are absent and SD1.5 weights do not match IllustriousXL. Larger weight download and extra residency require a separate evidence-backed decision.

install_safety: USDU __init__.py downloads upstream master.zip when submodule folder is empty. The audited pinned submodule was populated before import, preventing this fallback path. Core ComfyUI networking behavior was not changed.
policy: All Python runs in existing comfyui Conda; no torch upgrade, no overclock, no power/fan changes, no software temperature/power stop. Independent experiments use fresh processes and preserve baseline outputs.
